nodes.question: What is one of the effects of anaerobic digestion aside from producing biogas?
nodes.answer: Anaerobic digestion also mineralizes part of the organic nitrogen compounds into ammonium nitrogen, which is readily available for plant uptake.

nodes.question: How do longer distances to large pores affect microbial processes?
nodes.answer: Areas with longer distances to these pores may be more inclined towards anaerobic respiration due to extended diffusion distances.
